## Experienced Garage Door Services in Boca Raton

When Boca Raton residents contact Broten for garage door service, they can be certain they’re getting trained professionals to do the work. If you need [garage door repair in Boca Raton](https://www.broten.com/about/service-areas/boca-raton/repair/), contact Broten for services such as:

### SAME DAY GARAGE DOOR REPAIR SERVICES

No matter the problem with your garage door, [Broten can repair it](https://www.broten.com/service-support/repair/). Your garage door can become inoperable for a number of reasons that can lead your door to be stuck open, closed, or halfway between. Some problems can cause your door to open unevenly, which can lead to even more issues later.

Whatever the problem with your garage door may be, it can pose a safety risk and a security hazard. And when your garage door does break down, it’s hardly expected and usually comes at a bad time. That’s why Broten offers 24-hour emergency repair services. Our professionals are on-call and will arrive with the knowledge, tools, and parts to repair most makes and models of garage doors. No more waiting for the next business day to get your garage door fixed.

If it’s broken, contact Broten. We’ll even give you a lifetime warranty on any parts we use to fix the door, so you can be sure you won’t run into the same problem down the road.

If you want to catch small problems before they become bigger ones, contact us to perform a garage door check-up. We do [thorough garage door maintenance](https://www.broten.com/service-support/maintenance/) and check for worn-out parts, lubricate moving mechanisms, and perform a complete safety check. This regular maintenance will help keep your garage door working well and reduce the likelihood your door will need more expensive repairs later.

If you want a new garage door, call Broten to learn the choices that are available from companies such as Clopay® and LiftMaster®. We employ all of our own installers — we don’t use subcontractors. ## Are You Prepared for a Hurricane in Boca Raton?

Boca Raton residents have weathered hurricanes year after year. We know that you have a checklist ready when the forecast announces a hurricane is headed your way. But is your garage door prepared for it?

If your garage door is older than ten years, it probably isn’t ready for extreme weather because it likely isn’t hurricane-rated. Broten carries [hurricane-rated garage doors](https://www.broten.com/product/hurricane-garage-doors/) that meet Florida’s strict wind-resistance requirements. These doors are designed to hold up against strong winds and rain. If your door isn’t a hurricane-rated model, we advise you to upgrade to one immediately.
